title: Emerald Jungle
author: SwedenJohansson
summary: A large island made like Raft's big ones: dense jungle, cliffs and plenty to gather.
description:
Big enough to get lost in: thick trees and plants, rocks and ores, and animals in the shade. A good place to stock up.
Tick 'Also turn up while sailing' when you download it to meet it by chance in your worlds.
